sources.snippet: We also include a small portion of question-answering, and alignment style data to improve model accuracy. The model was pre-trained for more than 20 trillion tokens. The post-training corpus for NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 consists of high-quality curated and synthetically-generated data.

sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-DSpark is an open-weight language model from nvidia. AxForge deploys and operates it for you on dedicated EU-owned hardware — with the licence handled where one is required.

sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4-DSpark-MLX
sources.snippet: This release is the DSpark speculative decoding checkpoint intended to be paired with the Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B target model in vLLM. DSpark is designed to improve accepted length while preserving the latency benefits of block drafting on compact Blackwell systems such as DGX Spark.
